name: Fugitives
overview: Scripture reveals the reality of fugitives as individuals fleeing danger, oppression, or injustice, such as Moses escaping Pharaoh's wrath and Joseph fleeing to Egypt to protect the Christ child. The law in Deuteronomy commands that escaped servants not be returned to their masters but rather be allowed to live freely and without oppression among God's people. These passages highlight God's protection over those who seek refuge from harm, emphasizing mercy and justice within His covenant community.
